219548.description:
Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old student, can see ghosts and wears a bandage on his left cheek to hide his striking birthmark. One day, a girl with a scar on her forehead named Kouko Ishigami, accompanied by a ghost of a tall and friendly man, transfers into his class.

Fuuta quickly takes a liking to Kouko, wondering if it might be love at first sight. After waking up crying from a strange dream involving her, he feels a nostalgic connection to Kouko and becomes determined to befriend her. However, a chain of events forces Fuuta to reveal his birthmark to Kouko, to which she declares him to be the enemy of her life. A furious Kouko explains that the two are bound by reincarnation, and that Fuuta's birthmark is a curse she engraved on him in one of their past lives to recognize and eventually defeat him.

Kouko brings out a circular object made of flames known as the "spirit circle" and attacks Fuuta, pushing him off a flight of stairs. As he falls, Fuuta is thrown back into the insight of one of his previous lives. Spirit Circle chronicles Fuuta's journey back and forth his several past lives as he gradually unravels the mysteries behind his apparent bad blood with Kouko.

Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest.

In an effort to reach her, Hina’s dad does something that changes her life—he gives her a DVD of the Vampire Cross anime! Hina is instantly obsessed, especially with the character Mao. But it’s difficult to fangirl as hard as she wants from her bedroom in Romania, so now Hina is out of the house and off to Japan to live her otaku dream!

Kukulkan is a kingdom sustained by sound waves. Born with a power known as “Hizumi,” Agni was abandoned by the royal family and grew up surrounded by his guardian and friends. His power awakens Orochi, a force of calamity believed to have died a thousand years ago.When Orochi awakens, he calls Agni “my son.”

Who is Agni? What is this power for? To protect those he loves, the boy confronts the threat he has awakened. An epic adventure begins as sound and myth resonate together.

219866.description:
An unremarkable thirty-something man spends his days buried in work, with barely a moment to himself. When things finally settle down and he gets his first real break in ages, he decides it might be time to find something new to enjoy.

“Traveling sounds nice, for example.”

As if the universe heard him, his journey begins sooner than expected. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world—a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. And before he knows it, he's acquired tremendous power without even having to work for it. With that kind of strength at his disposal, three paths lie before him: side with humanity and become a hero, join the demons and unleash chaos upon the world… or choose neither and use his newfound power for nothing more than his own amusement. For him, the choice is obvious. And so begins one thirty-something nobody's journey through another world, living exactly as he pleases until he gets bored!

(Source: Hanashi Media)

One day, he was adopted by a family living in a luxurious, Japanese-style estate. Welcomed warmly by them all, Shota started letting his guard down but this family had a "secret" that the world could never know.

A new work from the creator of "The Cuckoo's Fiance" showcasing a different kind of "family." Thus begins a cozy, bloody love comedy!

Spacious apartment in a new building, an expansive kitchen with an induction stove, a bathroom with a separated toilet, and even a washroom, all for just... 4800 yen a month?! But there is a spooky reason Maison Shiba is so doggone affordable...

The room high schooler Kori Momose was offered came with a room mate: Mu-chan, a Shiba Inu who happens to be an earthbound spirit. With the ultimate goal of a comfortable lifestyle with no roommates, Kori tries all kinds of strategies to unbind Mu from room 101.

Get ready for a heartwarming comedy at Maison Shiba,full of quirky neighbors, adorable Shiba inus, and plenty of fluffy, chaotic fun!

219798.description:
The new series from Tomoko Ninomiya, creator of Nodame Cantabile, turns its focus on the world of jewelry! Shinobu, a second-year in high school, is part of the family that runs Kurata-ya, a storied pawn shop based in a breezy central Tokyo neighborhood. She helps run the place when school isn’t calling, and she has a natural gift that aids her a great deal—the ability to see the “aura” released by gemstones! Shinobu doesn’t have a boyfriend, but she does have a fiancé handpicked for her by her grandfather—Akisada Kitagami, a man from a prestigious family who wound up being taken in by Kurata-ya at a young age. He now works as a salesman for a first-class jewelry brand, but he’s also got more than his fair share of secrets…

(Source: K MANGA)

“I was meant to play baseball!”

Jiro Ayasegawa has a natural gift for sports, but life can be lonely at the top. He’s crushed other players’ dreams. Some have even given up their sport altogether because of him. 219986.description:
Above Canaan Academy, the Soul Clan and the Heavenly Mansion Alliance clashed over the legendary Tuoshe Ancient Emperor. The Soul Emperor used the ancient jade to open his cave, beginning the struggle for the opportunity to become an Emperor.

With the help of the Void Devouring Flame, the Soul Emperor successfully obtained a preliminary Emperor-grade pill, while Xiao Yan's fate remained unknown during the struggle. The Soul Emperor successfully advanced to Dou Di and led the Soul Clan army to attack the Heavenly Mansion Alliance. Just when everyone was in despair, the Xiao Clan's bloodline stirred.

Gu Yuan realized that Xiao Yan might be breaking through to Dou Di, which became everyone's last hope. Everyone fought to the death to buy time for Xiao Yan to become an Emperor, and Xiao Yan lived up to their expectations, descending like a god, and thus the battle between the two Emperors is about to begin.

(Source: Tencent, translated, edited)
